title: Align Dev And Build Optimization Profiles
description: Split dev (fast compile, console-only) vs build (release LTO, vite minify/drop). Implement plan dev_build_opt_profiles.
summary: Split dev (fast compile, no debuginfo) from ship builds: [profile.release] uses thin LTO, CGU 1, strip; dev entrypoints (os run, wgpu native, repo CLI run) use profile.dev. Added semioViteProductionBuild() for production Vite bundles; Go build -trimpath -s -w; CMake linux/macos Release presets.
